newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cullinan finalising merger, advises caution.
newsitem.headline: Cullinan finalising merger, advises caution.

text.p: Industrial holding firm Cullinan Holdings Ltd said on Friday the legal agreement constituting its reverse takeover by unlisted Midmacor Industries Ltd and its interim results were being finalised.

An announcement on the results together with details of the terms and effects of the merger was expected to be published around August 15 and a shareholder meeting to approve the merger would be held before September 30.

It said the significant costs stemming from the "extensive reconfiguration" of Cullinan's existing businesses, which had to be undertaken to reduce debt and prepare the company for the new direction resulting from the merger, would be taken into account in the results and have a major effect on its net asset value.
This would be reflected in terms of the merger, it said.
Shareholders were advised to continue exercising caution in their sharedealings until further notice.
